scene_description: A woman wearing a pink top, jeans, and yellow rubber gloves is kneeling on a kitchen floor. She is holding a mop head over a blue bucket. A cleaning cart with supplies is nearby. The setting is a white kitchen with cabinets and appliances in the background.

A young boy is sitting on green grass next to a large tree trunk. There are American flags visible nearby, and a driveway or road can be seen in the background. The boy is wearing a blue hoodie and blue sneakers.
